question.text: A positive charge $Q$ is situated at the centre of a cube. The electric flux through any face of the cube is (in SI units)

solution.text: The positive charge $Q$ is situated at the centre of a cube According to Gauss theorem, the flux from any closed surface $$ \phi_{E}=\frac{Q}{\varepsilon_{0}} $$ Cube has 6 faces, so electric flux from any face $\phi_{z}=\frac{Q}{6 \varepsilon_{0}}$
